name: Dormitory inspection
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
1. Drag the trash to the bin.
2. Use the plunger to clean the toilet.
3. Use the broom to sweep the floor.
4. Drag the blanket and the posters to tidy the room.
5. Have the two students climb onto the top bunk to hide before the inspector enters.
